diffres_resample_particles_diffusion.upstream_call: jax.jit(lambda k, lw, x: diffres.resampling.diffusion_resampling(k, lw, x, a, ts, integrator=integrator, ode=ode, jitter=jitter))(key, log_ws_normalised, samples), ts = jnp.linspace(0., T, nsteps + 1); einsum left at upstream default False
diffres_resample_particles_diffusion.jit_rationale: experiments/gms/diffusion.py wraps the call in jax.jit; bitwise equal to the script output. The demo notebook calls it eagerly; eager vs jit differ by ~1e-13 (executor reports the same effect).

parameters.particles_path: required; .npz with samples (N, ...) and exactly one of log_weights / weights
parameters.a: default -2.0 (demos/gaussian_mixture.ipynb cell 6; no default in the upstream signature; experiments/run_gms.sh uses -1, the gms script default is -0.5); must be < 0 (upstream docstring: 'must be negative'). a is the OU mean-reversion rate of the reference process dX = a (X - mu) dt + b dW with b^2 = -2 a var, whose stationary law is the weighted empirical diagonal Gaussian N(mu, var).
parameters.integrator: Literal euler | lord_and_rougemont | jentzen_and_kloeden | diffrax | tweedie; default 'euler' from the upstream signature ('tme' omitted: upstream always raises NotImplementedError)
parameters.ode: default True from the upstream signature
parameters.jitter: default 0.0 from the upstream signature; >= 0; exposed because a zero-variance dimension makes the reference degenerate
parameters.seed / prng_key: PRNGKey(seed) (default 0) or raw uint32[2] key; key used is returned
parameters.output_dir: base dir; fresh uuid subdirectory per call; default <project>/tmp/outputs/diffres_resample_particles_diffusion

diffres_resample_particles_diffusion.checks: a < 0, T > 0, nsteps >= 1, jitter >= 0; diffrax requires ode=True and tweedie requires ode=False (upstream raises NotImplementedError('Unknown integrator ...') otherwise; the wrapper raises ValueError with the reason before calling); non-finite output -> ValueError suggesting jitter
diffres_resample_particles_diffusion.outputs: resampled.npz with samples (N, ...) and log_weights (N,) as returned upstream (= -log N); dict with n_particles, sample_shape, input_weight_field, input_log_normaliser, ess_input, ess_output (diffres.feynman_kac.compute_ess), settings, prng_key, artifacts

diffres_resample_particles_baseline.upstream_call: jax.jit(lambda k, lw, x: f(k, lw, x, **method_kwargs))(key, log_ws_normalised, samples) with f in {multinomial, stratified, systematic, multinomial_stopped, ensemble_ot(eps), soft_resampling(alpha), gumbel_softmax(tau)}
diffres_resample_particles_baseline.jit_rationale: experiments/gms/{baselines,ot,soft,gumbel}.py jit the resampler; bitwise equal to their outputs

parameters.method: Literal multinomial | stratified | systematic | multinomial_stopped | ensemble_ot | soft | gumbel_softmax; default multinomial
parameters.alpha: soft only; None -> 0.5 (experiments/gms/soft.py argparse default; no default in the upstream function); must be in [0, 1] (upstream docstring)
parameters.tau: gumbel_softmax only; None -> 0.5 (experiments/gms/gumbel.py argparse default; no default in the upstream function); > 0 (upstream docstring; tau=0 divides by zero)
parameters.method_parameter_policy: passing eps/alpha/tau for a method they do not belong to raises ValueError (chosen over silently ignoring)
parameters.implicit_diff: not exposed (ensemble_ot upstream default True kept); it only changes gradients, and this tool returns no gradients

diffres_resample_particles_baseline.outputs: resampled.npz with samples and log_weights as returned upstream (uniform -log N except soft, which returns normalised non-uniform log weights; multinomial_stopped returns -log N + lw[i] - stop_gradient(lw[i]) which is -log N up to rounding); dict with output_weights_uniform flag, ess_input/ess_output, resolved settings (eps value and its source), prng_key, artifacts

io_adaptations: Input .npz contract: samples (N, ...) float, exactly one of log_weights (N,) or weights (N,). weights -> log(weights) (zeros allowed -> -inf). NaN/+inf log weights, negative/non-finite weights, non-finite samples, N < 2 and all-zero weights are rejected with ValueError.

Log weights are normalised with log_ws - logsumexp(log_ws) as every upstream caller does before calling the resampler; the input log normaliser is returned. For already-normalised inputs this can change log weights by ~1e-16.

Samples are passed with their stored shape: diffusion_resampling and the index/softmax-based resamplers accept (N,) or (N, ...) upstream. ensemble_ot needs an ott point cloud, so 1-D samples are reshaped to (N, 1) for the call and back to (N,) afterwards; samples with more than 2 dims are rejected for ensemble_ot only.
jax_enable_x64 set at import; CPU float64 as in upstream experiments/tests.
Outputs written to a fresh uuid directory per call; no full arrays are returned.
scientific_transformations_added: none (logsumexp normalisation is the upstream callers' own step; ESS uses diffres.feynman_kac.compute_ess)
known_limits_documented: diffusion_resampling, ensemble_ot and gumbel_softmax build (N, N[, d]) float64 arrays; memory grows as 8*N^2*d bytes per array (no wrapper guard added).
integrator='diffrax' re-solves the full ODE inside every scan step (upstream behaviour).
